items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: Mike (sure?), he wanted me to come out to Billy Berg's you know and play. ... And Mike did all of the booking and everything.

ctx.x: What made you go out there? (Marty Goub)
Well, Mike (sure?), he wanted me to come out to Billy Berg's you know and play.
